notes: Tuning for people. Each section belongs to one module: founding (src/people/founding.rs), needs (src/people/needs.rs), actions (src/people/decide.rs), life (src/people/life.rs), status (src/people/status.rs), economy (src/economy.rs), tools (src/tools.rs), caravan (src/caravan.rs).
All numbers are integers. Shares and multipliers are per mille.

founding.age_table_note: [lowest age of a five-year band, per mille of people in it]: a pre-modern population with life expectancy around 30.
founding.skill_share_note: Each adult knows each of the city's non-baseline technologies with this chance (if they know its prerequisites). Children know the baseline.

caravan.min_adults_note: Adults of one city who must choose to settle away on the same day for a caravan to leave; with their children that is a group of about a dozen, the size of a small band.
caravan.km_per_day_note: On open plains. Groups on foot with children, loads and herds make about 15-25 km a day.
caravan.terrain_cost_note: Per mille of a tile's width: how much longer it takes to cross hills and mountains than plains.
caravan.river_crossing_note: Extra cost of entering a river tile (finding a ford, rafting), per mille of its width.
caravan.scout_radius_km_note: How far ahead scouts and word of mouth reach. Must exceed the minimum distance between cities, or there is nothing to find.
caravan.min_site_score_note: Lowest site value (cradle score, or half the fertility of other settleable land) worth settling.
caravan.max_days_note: After about eight months on the road the caravan gives up and goes home.
caravan.food_days_note: Most food taken along, in days per member; the rest stays in the stores.
